title: Chartwise etale morphism of algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A morphism $f:X\to Y$ is chartwise etale if, for every $S$-scheme $T$ and every representable etale morphism $a:h_T\to X$, the composite $f\circ a:h_T\to Y$ is representable etale. Here $h_T$ is the scheme Yoneda presheaf and representable etale has the scheme-test meaning of [def-trf-algebraic-space]. The morphism $f$ itself is not required to be representable.
